lessons.title: IA en finanzas y back office
lessons.summary: Facturas, conciliaciones y cierre.

cards.title: Procesamiento de facturas
cards.text: La IA extrae proveedor, fechas, importes, IVA y líneas de las facturas con cualquier formato, las cuadra con pedidos de compra y recepciones de mercancía y señala las discrepancias.

deep.x: Accounts payable is one of the most proven areas for AI. Modern systems read invoices in any layout, extract the data and match it to orders, leaving people to handle exceptions.
Fields extracted
Old vs new
E-invoicing changes the picture

Structured e-invoices are spreading across Europe. Portugal requires certified invoicing software and unique document codes (ATCUD), and EU rules (ViDA) will make e-invoicing mandatory for many cross-border transactions from 2030. Structured data reduces the need for extraction, but AI remains useful for validation and exceptions.
Aim for "touchless" processing of routine invoices and fast, well-informed handling of the rest.

cards.title: Conciliación a tres bandas
cards.text: Control clásico de cuentas a pagar: factura, pedido de compra y recepción de mercancía deben coincidir en cantidades y precios. La IA acelera el cruce y explica las discrepancias.

deep.x: The three-way match is a core accounts payable control: before paying, check that the invoice, purchase order and goods receipt agree.

items: Purchase order: what was ordered, at what price

deep.x: Typical mismatches
Tolerances
Small differences within agreed tolerances (for example ±2% or a few euros) pass automatically. Larger ones go to a buyer or AP clerk.
Where AI helps

x: Matching when PO numbers are missing or wrong, using supplier, items and amounts
Handling partial deliveries split across invoices
Explaining mismatches in plain language: "price is 3% above PO; contract allows annual indexation in January"

deep.x: A two-way match (invoice versus PO only) is common for services, where there's no physical goods receipt.

cards.title: Conciliaciones
cards.text: Cuadrar extractos bancarios, saldos intercompañía y libros contables es repetitivo. El ML puede emparejar transacciones con referencias imprecisas y aprender de los emparejamientos manuales anteriores.

deep.x: Reconciliation means checking that two records of the same thing agree: bank statements against the ledger, or one company's intercompany balance against another's.
Why it's hard
Machine learning helps
ML learns from past manual matches: which reference patterns go together, typical fee deductions, which customer pays several invoices in one transfer. Match rates rise over time.
Intercompany
Large groups have thousands of intercompany transactions. Mismatches delay consolidation at month-end, so automated matching and dispute workflows save days.
Reconcile continuously, not just at month-end.

cards.title: Cierre financiero
cards.text: La IA puede redactar explicaciones de desviaciones, revisar asientos en busca de anomalías y resumir el estado del cierre, acortando el cierre de mes.

deep.x: The month-end close is the process of finalising the books for a period. It's deadline-driven and full of repetitive checks, a strong fit for AI assistance.
Where AI helps
Variance explanations

AI can compare actuals with budget and prior periods, look up underlying transactions and draft explanations: "freight costs +18% due to higher Brazil–Rotterdam rates in March". Controllers review and refine.
Journal entry checks

x: Unusual amounts or accounts
Entries posted at odd times or by unusual users
Round numbers or just below approval limits
Manual entries to rarely used accounts

deep.x: Faster close is valuable mainly because it frees finance time for analysis and gives management earlier information.

cards.title: Previsión de tesorería

steps: El modelo prevé fechas de cobro

cards.text: Los modelos de ML prevén los cobros de clientes y los pagos a proveedores a partir del histórico, lo que mejora la planificación de tesorería y capital circulante.

deep.x: Cash forecasting predicts money coming in and going out over days, weeks and months. Better forecasts mean less idle cash, less borrowing and fewer surprises.
Inflows
ML learns how each customer actually pays: some always pay 10 days late, some pay early at quarter-end. That's more accurate than assuming everyone pays on the due date.
Outflows
Why it matters in commodities
Commodity traders face large, volatile cash needs: margin calls on futures, letters of credit and big cargo payments. Accurate forecasts reduce costly emergency funding.
Forecast ranges, not single numbers: treasury needs to know the plausible worst case.

cards.title: Fraude y anomalías
cards.text: Detecta facturas duplicadas, pagos inusuales, cambios de datos bancarios y proveedores sospechosos antes de que salga el dinero.

deep.x: Finance AI can catch fraud and errors before money leaves the company: duplicate invoices, changed bank details, unusual payments and fake vendors.
Business email compromise
Fraudsters impersonate suppliers or executives by email, often asking to update bank details or make urgent payments. The FBI reports losses of billions of dollars a year from this type of fraud.
Duplicate invoices
Duplicates often differ slightly: an extra space in the number, a different date format, a scanned copy plus an email copy. Fuzzy matching catches them.
Combining rules and ML

x: Rules catch known risks reliably
Anomaly detection finds new patterns
Humans investigate flagged cases

deep.x: Generative AI makes phishing emails and even voice deepfakes more convincing, which raises the importance of verification by a separate channel.

cards.title: Auditoría de gastos
cards.text: La IA lee los tiques, los contrasta con la política y señala las excepciones, para que los auditores revisen los pocos casos de riesgo en lugar de muestrear al azar.

deep.x: AI reads every expense receipt, checks it against policy and flags the risky few, instead of auditors sampling a small random share.
What it checks
Example flags

x: Hotel claimed on a day when the employee was on leave
Same receipt submitted twice by different colleagues
Alcohol claimed under "meals" above policy limits
Expenses on weekends without travel

deep.x: Benefits
Most employees get faster reimbursement because clean claims pass automatically. Auditors focus on real issues.
Check everything automatically; investigate selectively.

cards.title: Controles y auditabilidad
cards.text: Finanzas necesita trazabilidad completa: cada asiento propuesto por la IA debe mostrar los documentos de origen, la confianza y quién lo aprobó. Los auditores deben poder seguir el rastro.

deep.x: Finance runs on controls and evidence. Any AI involved in postings or payments must leave a trail auditors can follow.
What must be recorded
Segregation of duties
AI shouldn't break the principle that no single person (or system) both creates and approves a payment. Approval workflows still apply.
Auditor expectations
SOX and similar
Companies subject to the US Sarbanes-Oxley Act or similar internal control regimes must document and test controls involving AI just like any other.

deep.r: good AI processes can make audits easier, with complete logs instead of scattered emails

cards.title: Integración con el ERP
cards.text: El valor llega cuando la IA está conectada al ERP (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, Dynamics): lee datos maestros, propone asientos y actualiza flujos de trabajo.

deep.x: Value comes when AI is connected to the ERP, the core system of record for finance, procurement and operations, rather than working on exported spreadsheets.
Major ERPs
Integration approaches

items.b: built-in copilots from the ERP vendor
integration platforms between AI and ERP

deep.x: SAP migrations
Many companies are moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA ahead of mainstream maintenance ending in 2027. These migrations are a chance to design AI into processes from the start.

x: Clean master data first: AI relies on it
Use standard APIs rather than direct database writes

deep.x: AI that can't write back to the ERP leaves people retyping its results.

cards.title: Medir la IA en finanzas
cards.text: Sigue la tasa de procesamiento sin intervención, el tiempo de ciclo, la tasa de errores, el coste por factura, los días de cierre y los descuentos por pronto pago obtenidos.

deep.x: Finance AI is measurable, which makes it a good place to build a credible AI track record.
Example before and after
Key metrics
Value beyond cost

x: Fewer late payment penalties and better supplier relationships
Earlier visibility of liabilities
Better fraud prevention
Finance staff time moved to analysis

deep.x: Report value in finance's own language: cost per transaction, days, euros and control quality.

quiz.q: ¿Qué es una conciliación a tres bandas?
options: Cuadrar pedido de compra, recepción de mercancía y factura
quiz.explain: Control clásico de cuentas a pagar.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué la IA en finanzas debe mantener una pista de auditoría?
options: Para que los auditores puedan rastrear cada asiento hasta sus fuentes y aprobaciones
quiz.explain: La trazabilidad es esencial.

quiz.q: ¿Qué mide la «tasa sin intervención» (touchless rate)?
options: La proporción de elementos procesados sin intervención humana
quiz.explain: Un KPI clave de automatización.

lessons.title: IA en operaciones y materias primas
lessons.summary: Previsión, logística y apoyo al trading.

cards.title: Previsión de la demanda
cards.text: El ML prevé la demanda usando el histórico, la estacionalidad, los precios, el clima y los eventos, mejora las medias simples y ayuda a planificar la producción y el stock.

deep.x: Demand forecasting predicts how much customers will buy. Machine learning can combine many signals and typically beats simple averages, especially for products with complex patterns.
Typical improvement
Why it matters
Better forecasts mean less stock tied up, fewer stockouts, less waste of perishable goods and smoother production.
Hierarchy
Forecasts are needed at many levels: total, region, product, store. Good systems keep them consistent from the top down.
Forecasts are always wrong; the goal is to be less wrong, and to know how uncertain the forecast is.

cards.title: Visibilidad de la cadena de suministro
cards.text: La IA combina datos del ERP, transportistas, puertos y proveedores para predecir retrasos y sugerir acciones, como cambiar rutas o repriorizar pedidos.

deep.x: Supply chain visibility means knowing where goods are and when they'll arrive. AI combines many data sources to predict delays and suggest responses before problems hit.
Data sources
Predictive alerts

items: learn about delay on arrival day

deep.x: Typical actions

x: Reroute shipments or switch ports
Reprioritise customer orders
Expedite alternatives
Inform customers proactively

deep.x: Visibility is valuable only when it leads to earlier, better decisions.

cards.title: Optimización logística
cards.text: La optimización y el ML planifican rutas, calendarios de buques, preparación de pedidos en almacén y carga de camiones, reduciendo costes y emisiones.

deep.x: Optimisation algorithms and machine learning plan routes, schedules and loads, cutting cost, time and emissions across logistics networks.
Optimisation plus ML
Example
A route optimiser for a delivery fleet considers time windows, vehicle capacity, driver hours and traffic, problems far too large to solve well by hand.
Benefits

x: Fewer kilometres and less fuel
Better vehicle and vessel utilisation
More reliable delivery times

deep.x: UPS's ORION route optimisation system is reported to save about 100 million miles a year.

cards.title: Mantenimiento predictivo
cards.text: Los sensores de las máquinas (vibración, temperatura, potencia) alimentan modelos que predicen averías, para que el mantenimiento se haga antes de que se rompan.

deep.x: Predictive maintenance uses sensor data to forecast equipment failures, so repairs happen just before they're needed rather than too early or too late.
Maintenance strategies

items: Predictive: fix before failure based on condition
Preventive: fix on a fixed schedule

deep.x: Typical signals
Benefits

Industry estimates commonly cite meaningful reductions in unplanned downtime and maintenance costs, particularly for critical equipment like conveyors, crushers, pumps and compressors in plants and ports.
Requirements

x: Sensors and connectivity on key equipment
History of failures to learn from
Maintenance teams that trust and act on alerts

deep.x: Start with the few machines whose failure stops everything.

cards.title: Señales de precio de materias primas
cards.text: Los modelos combinan datos de oferta y demanda, clima, estado de los cultivos, fletes e indicadores macro para apoyar la visión de los analistas. Informan el criterio de trading, no lo sustituyen.

deep.x: Price models in commodities combine fundamental data, weather, freight and macro indicators. They support analysts and traders; they don't replace judgement.
Fundamentals
Where AI helps

x: Processing far more data sources than an analyst can read
Summarising reports, news and policy announcements in many languages
Detecting patterns in positioning and flows
Scenario analysis

deep.x: Limits

deep.w: An AI model can reliably predict commodity prices
deep.r: markets react to new information quickly; models provide an edge in analysis, not certainty

cards.title: Datos satelitales y meteorológicos
cards.text: Las imágenes de satélite y las previsiones meteorológicas ayudan a estimar la salud y el rendimiento de los cultivos en regiones como Brasil, el Medio Oeste de EE. UU. y el mar Negro antes de los informes oficiales.

deep.x: Satellite imagery and weather forecasts help estimate crop conditions and yields across major producing regions, often before official reports.
Key regions
Free and commercial data
The EU's Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellites provide free imagery at 10 m resolution, revisiting each spot every few days. Commercial providers offer higher resolution and daily coverage.
What's measured
Official reports
The USDA's monthly WASDE report is a key market event. Satellite-based estimates help analysts anticipate it.
Clouds are a major obstacle for optical satellites; radar satellites like Sentinel-1 can see through clouds.

cards.title: Inteligencia contractual
cards.text: La IA generativa extrae los términos clave de los contratos comerciales (cantidades, especificaciones de calidad, periodos de embarque, Incoterms, demora, condiciones de pago) y señala cláusulas inusuales.

deep.x: Trade contracts contain many terms that affect cost and risk. Generative AI extracts them into structured data and flags unusual clauses for review.
Incoterms
The International Chamber of Commerce's Incoterms (current version 2020) define who pays for transport, insurance and risk at each stage. FOB and CIF are common in bulk commodities.
Flagging deviations
Benefits

x: Faster contract review and fewer missed obligations
A searchable database of all terms across thousands of contracts
Earlier detection of risky terms

deep.x: Structured contract data turns documents into something you can analyse.

cards.title: Operaciones comerciales
cards.text: La IA ayuda con los documentos (conocimientos de embarque, certificados, cartas de crédito): comprueba su coherencia y detecta discrepancias antes de que retrasen los pagos.

deep.x: Commodity trade involves many documents that must agree exactly. Discrepancies delay payments and cargo, so AI checks consistency before submission.
Letters of credit

A letter of credit is a bank's promise to pay when documents match the credit's terms exactly. Banks check documents under international rules (UCP 600), and a large share of first presentations are rejected for discrepancies.
Typical discrepancies
Digital trade documents
Electronic bills of lading are gaining legal recognition, for example under the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, reducing paper and fraud risk.
A single discrepancy in a letter of credit, such as a misspelled port name, can delay payment of millions of euros.

cards.title: Riesgo y cumplimiento
cards.text: El control de sanciones, el riesgo de contraparte y el seguimiento de buques se benefician de una IA que vigila noticias, datos de propiedad y movimientos de barcos.

deep.x: Trading firms must screen counterparties, vessels and transactions for sanctions and other risks. AI helps monitor large, fast-changing data.
Vessel tracking
Ships broadcast their positions through AIS. Gaps in signals ("going dark"), unusual ship-to-ship transfers and route anomalies can indicate sanctions evasion.
Adverse media
Beneficial ownership
Sanctioned parties often hide behind layers of companies. Graph analytics trace ownership chains across registries.
AI can screen everything; compliance experts decide.

cards.title: Personas en el circuito
cards.text: En trading y operaciones, la IA aporta señales y automatización, mientras que personas con experiencia toman las decisiones comerciales y de riesgo.

deep.x: In trading and operations, AI provides signals, analysis and automation, while experienced people make commercial and risk decisions.
Why humans stay in charge

x: Markets change in ways history doesn't predict
Relationships and negotiation drive commercial outcomes
Accountability for large risk decisions must sit with people
Regulation and internal controls require it

deep.x: Augmentation
Designing the split
Algorithmic trading is common in financial markets, but physical commodity trading still relies heavily on human judgement because of logistics, quality and relationships.

quiz.q: ¿Qué utiliza el mantenimiento predictivo?
options: Datos de sensores para predecir averías
quiz.explain: Reparar antes de que se rompa.

quiz.q: En los contratos comerciales, ¿qué es la demora (demurrage)?
options: Un cargo diario cuando un buque se retrasa más allá de la plancha acordada
quiz.explain: Normalmente es una tarifa diaria.

quiz.q: ¿Quién debe tomar las decisiones finales de trading?
options: Personas con experiencia, usando las señales de la IA
quiz.explain: La IA informa; las personas deciden.

lessons.title: IA en atención al cliente y ventas
lessons.summary: Respuestas más rápidas y mejores ventas.

cards.title: Copilotos de soporte
cards.text: La IA redacta respuestas para los agentes usando bases de conocimiento y el historial de casos. Los agentes editan y envían, y atienden más casos con una calidad constante.

deep.x: A support copilot works alongside human agents: it reads the customer's message and history, searches the knowledge base and drafts a reply that the agent edits and sends.

steps: Copilot reads history and knowledge base

deep.x: Evidence

A large 2023 study of over 5,000 customer support agents (Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond) found an AI assistant increased issues resolved per hour by about 14% on average, and by around 34% for the least experienced agents.
The most experienced agents saw little measurable change: the assistant mainly spread their know-how to others.
What copilots do
Why start here

x: Humans still review every reply, so risk is low
Gains are measurable: handling time, resolution rate
Agents' edits become training and evaluation data

deep.x: Copilots spread the knowledge of your best agents to everyone.

cards.title: Asistentes de autoservicio
cards.text: Los asistentes de cara al cliente responden preguntas habituales 24/7 y pasan a una persona los casos complejos o delicados, con todo el contexto.

deep.x: Customer-facing assistants answer common questions around the clock, take simple actions and hand over to humans when needed, passing on the full context.

steps: Complex or upset? Hand over with summary

deep.x: What works well
A high-profile example

In 2024, Klarna reported its AI assistant handled two-thirds of its customer service chats in its first month, equivalent to about 700 full-time agents. In 2025 the company emphasised that customers must always be able to reach a human, after concerns about service quality.
Good handover
Guardrails

x: Answer only from approved knowledge, with sources
Never invent policies, prices or promises
Recognise frustration and escalate early

deep.x: Customers often prefer self-service for simple tasks, but strongly dislike being trapped with a bot when their problem is complex.

cards.title: Triaje de tickets
cards.text: Clasifica las solicitudes entrantes por tema, urgencia e idioma, y derívalas automáticamente al equipo adecuado.

deep.x: Triage classifies incoming requests by topic, urgency, language and customer value, then routes them to the right team, often in seconds rather than hours.
Before and after
Extra value

x: Extract order numbers and account details automatically
Detect duplicates and link related tickets
Spot emerging issues: a spike in "app won't open" tickets signals an outage

deep.x: Triage is a quiet, high-volume win: small time savings on every single ticket.

cards.title: Sentimiento y calidad
cards.text: La IA analiza las conversaciones en busca de sentimiento, problemas recurrentes y cumplimiento, y da a los responsables una visión de todas las interacciones, no solo de muestras.

deep.x: AI can analyse every customer conversation, not just a small sample, revealing sentiment trends, recurring problems and compliance issues.
From sampling to full coverage
Insights for the business
Contact reasons reveal broken processes elsewhere: confusing invoices, late deliveries, unclear product instructions. Fixing the cause reduces contacts entirely.
Caution

x: Use it for coaching and insight, not covert surveillance of employees
Inform staff and involve employee representatives where required
Emotion recognition systems are banned in EU workplaces under the AI Act; analysing text for topic and customer satisfaction is different, but check with legal

deep.x: The best contact is the one that never needed to happen.

cards.title: Asistentes de ventas
cards.text: La IA prepara informes de cuentas, resume reuniones, redacta propuestas y actualiza el CRM, para que los comerciales tengan más tiempo con los clientes.

deep.x: AI sales assistants handle preparation and admin, giving salespeople more time with customers.
Before a meeting
The assistant gathers recent orders, open issues, news about the customer and notes from past meetings into a one-page briefing.
After a meeting
Where time goes
Keeping it human
Customers value genuine relationships. AI should free time for real conversations, not flood customers with generic automated emails.
CRM data quality often improves with AI because updates happen automatically instead of relying on busy salespeople to type them.

cards.title: Puntuación de leads
cards.text: El ML puntúa los leads según su probabilidad de compra, a partir de ventas anteriores, comportamiento y datos firmográficos, para que ventas se centre en los más prometedores.

deep.x: Lead scoring uses machine learning to estimate how likely each prospect is to buy, so sales teams spend time on the most promising leads.
Inputs
Making scores useful

x: Explain the main reasons for each score, so salespeople trust it
Retrain as markets and products change
Compare outcomes against salespeople's own judgement

deep.x: Pitfalls

items.b: low-scored leads never get called, so they never convert
past focus on certain regions repeats

deep.x: Use scores to prioritise, and keep testing some low-scored leads to check the model is right.

cards.title: Apoyo a la fijación de precios
cards.text: Los modelos sugieren precios o descuentos según el historial de operaciones, la demanda y la competencia, dentro de los límites fijados por el negocio.

deep.x: AI pricing tools suggest prices or discounts based on deal history, demand, costs and competition, while the business sets the guardrails.
Inputs
Guardrails

x: Minimum margins and maximum discounts
Approval needed outside the range
Rules against discriminatory pricing
Competition law limits: no sharing or aligning prices with competitors

deep.x: Dynamic pricing
Competition law

Using shared pricing algorithms or competitor data platforms can raise antitrust concerns if they facilitate collusion. Regulators in the US and EU have scrutinised algorithmic pricing in sectors like rental housing.
Even small price improvements matter: in thin-margin businesses, a 1% better price can raise profit by far more than 1%.

cards.title: Personalización
cards.text: Recomendar productos y contenidos relevantes aumenta la conversión, pero hay que respetar la privacidad y no resultar intrusivo.

deep.x: Personalisation tailors products, content and offers to each customer. Done well, it raises conversion and satisfaction; done badly, it feels creepy or unfair.
How recommendations work
Privacy rules

x: GDPR requires a legal basis for profiling and transparency about it
Cookie and tracking consent rules apply to web behaviour
Avoid inferring sensitive data such as health or religion
Let customers see and adjust their preferences

deep.x: Business impact
Personalise to help customers, not just to sell more to them.

cards.title: Sé transparente
cards.text: Los clientes deben saber cuándo hablan con una IA y poder hablar siempre con una persona. El Reglamento de IA de la UE exige informar en los chatbots.

deep.x: Customers should know when they're dealing with AI and always have a path to a human. It's both a legal requirement and a trust builder.
EU AI Act

Providers must design AI systems that interact with people so that users are informed they're dealing with AI, unless it's obvious from context. Deepfakes and certain AI-generated content must be labelled. These transparency obligations apply from August 2026.
Good disclosure

items.w: Hidden bot with a human name
items.r: "I'm the virtual assistant, type 'agent' anytime to reach a person"

deep.x: Why it pays

x: Customers forgive AI mistakes more when they know it's AI
Clear escalation reduces frustration and complaints
Avoids regulatory and reputational risk

deep.x: Consumer protection law also applies: an AI agent that misleads customers creates the same liability as a misleading human employee.

cards.title: Medir la IA de servicio
cards.text: Sigue la tasa de resolución, el tiempo de gestión, la satisfacción del cliente, la tasa de escalado y la precisión de las respuestas. Vigila a los clientes que abandonan.

deep.x: Service AI should be judged by customer outcomes, not just cost. Watch for hidden failures like customers giving up.
The containment trap
Repeat contacts
If customers contact you again about the same issue within a few days, the first answer probably didn't solve it. Track repeat contact rates.
Audit answers
Regularly sample AI answers and check them against policy. A confident wrong answer about refunds can cost more than a slow right one.
Measure whether problems were solved, not whether humans were avoided.

quiz.q: ¿Qué hace un copiloto de soporte?
options: Redacta respuestas que los agentes revisan y envían
quiz.explain: Los agentes mantienen el control.

quiz.q: ¿Qué debe ofrecer un asistente de cara al cliente?
options: Una forma de hablar con una persona
quiz.explain: Traspaso a una persona e información clara.

quiz.q: ¿Qué es el triaje de tickets?
quiz.explain: El equipo correcto, con la prioridad correcta.

lessons.title: IA en RR. HH. y en el área legal
lessons.summary: Contratos, políticas y procesos de personas.

cards.title: Revisión de contratos
cards.text: La IA extrae las cláusulas clave (duración, renovación, responsabilidad, rescisión, ley aplicable), las compara con tus posiciones estándar y resalta las desviaciones para los abogados.

deep.x: AI contract review extracts key clauses, compares them with your standard positions and highlights deviations for lawyers to review.
Clauses typically extracted
Where it shines

x: High-volume, standardised contracts: NDAs, supplier agreements, leases
Due diligence: reviewing thousands of contracts in an acquisition
Contract repositories: finding all contracts with a given clause

deep.x: Limits
AI reads every page consistently; lawyers decide what matters.

cards.title: Bibliotecas de cláusulas y playbooks
cards.text: Un playbook legal define posiciones preferidas, aceptables e inaceptables para cada cláusula. La IA lo aplica de forma coherente en miles de contratos.

deep.x: A legal playbook defines, for each clause type, your preferred position, acceptable fallbacks and red lines. AI applies it consistently across thousands of contracts.
Example: limitation of liability

items.b: cap up to 200% with legal approval

deep.x: Benefits

x: Consistent positions across many lawyers and offices
Junior lawyers and business staff can handle standard contracts
Faster negotiations with suggested fallback wording

deep.x: Building the playbook
Writing the playbook often delivers value on its own, because it makes implicit expert knowledge explicit.

cards.title: Investigación jurídica

items.w: fiarse de citas de la IA
items.r: verificar cada una en bases oficiales

cards.text: La IA ayuda a buscar jurisprudencia y normativa, pero las citas deben verificarse: ya se ha sancionado a abogados por presentar casos inventados por la IA.

deep.x: AI can search case law, legislation and regulatory guidance quickly, but its citations must always be verified. Invented cases have embarrassed lawyers and courts.

items.w: Paste AI-cited cases into a court filing
items.r: Verify every citation in an authoritative database

deep.x: Famous failure
In Mata v. Avianca (2023), a US federal judge sanctioned two lawyers who submitted a brief citing six non-existent cases invented by ChatGPT. Similar incidents have since occurred in many countries.
Specialised tools
A 2024 Stanford study found even specialised legal AI research tools produced incorrect or misgrounded answers in a meaningful share of queries.
Good practice

x: Use AI to find leads, summarise and draft
Check every authority in primary sources
Read the cited cases, not just the summary

deep.x: In law, an unverified citation is a professional risk, not a shortcut.

cards.title: Asistentes de políticas
cards.text: Los empleados preguntan sobre políticas de RR. HH., normas de viaje o procedimientos de TI y obtienen respuestas basadas en documentos oficiales, con enlaces.

deep.x: Policy assistants answer employees' questions about HR policies, travel rules, IT procedures or expense limits, grounded in official documents with links.
Common questions
Requirements

x: Only approved, current documents in the knowledge base
Country-specific answers, since policies differ by location
Citations so employees can check the source
Escalation to HR for personal or sensitive cases

deep.x: Benefits
Policy assistants often reveal contradictions between documents, prompting HR to clean up outdated policies.

cards.title: Selección: con cuidado
cards.text: El cribado de CV y la clasificación de candidatos son de alto riesgo según el Reglamento de IA de la UE. Usa la IA como apoyo (redactar ofertas, programar entrevistas, resumir) y deja las decisiones a las personas, con pruebas de sesgo.

deep.x: AI in recruiting is high-risk. CV screening and candidate ranking can discriminate, and the EU AI Act classifies them as high-risk systems.
EU AI Act

AI systems used to recruit or select people, filter applications or evaluate candidates are listed as high-risk. Deployers must ensure human oversight, monitor the system, keep logs and inform candidates and workers.
Lessons from failures
An experimental Amazon CV-screening tool, reported in 2018, learned to downgrade CVs containing the word "women's" because it was trained on a decade of mostly male hires. Amazon abandoned it.
Safer practices

x: Use AI to assist recruiters, not to reject candidates automatically
Test outcomes by gender, age and other groups
Tell candidates when AI is used
Offer human review of decisions

deep.x: New York City requires annual independent bias audits of automated employment decision tools since 2023.

cards.title: Incorporación
cards.text: Los asistentes de IA guían a los nuevos empleados por los sistemas, las políticas y las primeras tareas, y responden preguntas en cualquier momento.

deep.x: AI assistants can guide new employees through systems, policies and first tasks, answering questions at any time without them feeling they're bothering colleagues.
A good onboarding assistant

x: Knows the role, location and team of the new hire
Gives a personalised checklist for the first weeks
Answers practical questions: "how do I book a meeting room?"
Escalates to the manager or HR for anything personal

deep.x: Benefits
Human connection
Let AI handle the practical questions so people can focus on relationships.

cards.title: Formación y desarrollo
cards.text: La IA crea contenidos formativos, cuestionarios e itinerarios personalizados, y hace de tutor, como esta app.

deep.x: AI can create learning content, quizzes and personalised paths, and act as a patient tutor available at any time.
Personalisation
Role-play
AI can simulate difficult conversations: a negotiation, a customer complaint, a performance review. Learners practise safely and get feedback.
Evidence on learning

x: Spaced repetition and retrieval practice (quizzes) strongly improve memory
Short, frequent sessions beat long, rare ones
Active practice beats passive reading

deep.x: Apps like this one use these principles: short cards, quizzes and repetition over time.

cards.title: Privacidad de los datos de empleados
cards.text: Los datos de RR. HH. son sensibles. Restringe el acceso, minimiza los datos, evita el reconocimiento de emociones en el trabajo (prohibido por el Reglamento de IA de la UE) e implica a los comités de empresa cuando sea obligatorio.

deep.x: HR data is among the most sensitive in any company. AI use with employee data needs strict limits and often consultation with employee representatives.
Banned and high-risk

items.b: emotion recognition at work (except medical or safety)
AI deciding promotions, terminations, task allocation, monitoring
employee consent rarely valid due to power imbalance

deep.x: Monitoring limits

Productivity monitoring tools that track keystrokes, screenshots or webcams raise major privacy issues and are restricted in many EU countries. In Portugal, the data protection authority (CNPD) has issued guidance against remote workers' constant monitoring.
Works councils
In countries like Germany, introducing technical systems that can monitor employees requires works council agreement.
Treat employee data with the same care you'd expect for your own.

cards.title: Vigilancia del cumplimiento
cards.text: La IA sigue los cambios normativos, los relaciona con las políticas internas y señala las carencias, ayudando a los equipos de cumplimiento a estar al día.

deep.x: Regulations change constantly. AI helps compliance teams track changes, map them to internal policies and flag gaps.
Sources
Typical uses

x: Horizon scanning: what's coming next year?
Mapping obligations to controls and owners
Answering questions about internal policies
Checking documents and communications for compliance issues

deep.x: Human expertise
EU regulation is extensive: the EU AI Act alone has 113 articles, 13 annexes and 180 recitals.

cards.title: Los abogados siguen siendo responsables
cards.text: La IA acelera el trabajo jurídico, pero la responsabilidad profesional sigue siendo de los abogados. Úsala para primeros borradores, revisión y apoyo a la investigación, con la validación de un experto.

deep.x: AI speeds up legal work, but professional responsibility stays with lawyers. Bar associations increasingly publish guidance on AI use.
Professional duties
Confidentiality
Client information must not go into tools that store or train on it without safeguards. Use enterprise tools with appropriate contracts.
Good practice

x: Clear firm policy on approved tools
Expert sign-off on all AI-assisted work
Record AI use where relevant
Train lawyers on limits, especially hallucinated citations

deep.x: AI is a powerful junior colleague: fast, tireless and in need of supervision.

quiz.q: Según el Reglamento de IA de la UE, una IA que clasifica candidatos a un empleo es de…
quiz.explain: Los usos en el empleo son de alto riesgo.

quiz.q: ¿Qué define un playbook legal?
options: Posiciones preferidas, aceptables e inaceptables para cada cláusula
quiz.explain: La IA lo aplica de forma coherente.

quiz.q: ¿Qué práctica está prohibida en el trabajo según el Reglamento de IA de la UE?
options: El reconocimiento de emociones (con excepciones limitadas)
quiz.explain: Prohibido desde febrero de 2025.

lessons.title: IA para la ingeniería de software
lessons.summary: Copilotos, agentes y modernización del código.

cards.title: Asistentes de programación
cards.text: Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Cursor y Claude Code sugieren código, lo explican, escriben pruebas y corrigen errores, dentro del editor o la terminal del desarrollador.

deep.x: AI coding assistants suggest code, explain it, write tests and fix bugs, inside the developer's editor or terminal.
Modes of use

items.b: suggests the next lines while typing
changes code across files on request
carries out whole tasks and runs tests

deep.x: Rapid adoption
Coding was one of the first areas where generative AI reached mass use. Google said in late 2024 that more than a quarter of its new code was generated by AI and then reviewed by engineers.
Good uses

x: Boilerplate and repetitive code
Unfamiliar languages and libraries
Explaining legacy code
Writing tests and documentation

deep.x: Assistants handle the typing; developers stay responsible for the design and the result.

cards.title: Mejoras de productividad
cards.text: Estudios controlados han observado que los desarrolladores completan algunas tareas de programación bastante más rápido con asistentes de IA, aunque la mejora varía según la tarea, la experiencia y la base de código.

deep.x: Studies show real but uneven productivity gains from AI coding tools. The size depends heavily on the task, the developer and the codebase.

items.b: ~19% slower for experts on own codebases

deep.x: The studies

x: A 2022 GitHub experiment found developers completed a defined task (an HTTP server in JavaScript) about 56% faster with Copilot
A 2025 METR study of experienced open-source developers working on their own large codebases found they were about 19% slower with AI tools, despite believing they were faster

deep.x: Why results differ
Measure your own
Run your own trials and track delivery metrics rather than relying on vendor claims or developers' impressions.

deep.w: Developers know how much AI speeds them up
deep.r: perceived and measured speed-ups can differ substantially

cards.title: Agentes de programación
cards.text: Los agentes toman una tarea (una incidencia o un ticket), planifican cambios en varios archivos, ejecutan las pruebas y abren una pull request para revisión humana.

deep.x: Coding agents take a task, such as a ticket or issue, explore the codebase, plan changes across files, run tests and propose a pull request for human review.
What they're good at
Benchmarks
SWE-bench measures agents on real GitHub issues from open-source projects. Scores rose from a few percent in 2023 to well over half on its verified subset by 2025.
Working with agents

x: Write clear tickets with acceptance criteria
Give the agent a way to run tests
Review changes like a colleague's pull request
Start with low-risk repositories

deep.x: The quality of the ticket often decides the quality of the agent's work.

cards.title: La revisión de código sigue importando
cards.text: El código generado por IA puede contener errores, fallos de seguridad o problemas de licencia. Mantén la revisión de código, las pruebas y el análisis de seguridad en el pipeline.

deep.x: AI-generated code can look polished while containing bugs, security flaws or licence issues. Review, testing and scanning remain essential.
Why review gets harder
Pipeline safeguards
Research findings

The 2024 DORA State of DevOps report found that increased AI adoption was associated with a small decrease in software delivery stability, suggesting teams need to keep batch sizes small and testing strong.

x: Keep pull requests small
Require tests for AI-written changes
Use AI reviewers as an extra layer, not a replacement

deep.x: Speed in writing code is wasted if it slows down reviewing and fixing it.

cards.title: Modernización del legado
cards.text: La IA ayuda a entender y documentar código heredado (COBOL, ABAP antiguo), sugiere migraciones y genera pruebas, acelerando proyectos de modernización como el paso a S/4HANA.

deep.x: Many companies run critical systems written decades ago in COBOL, old ABAP or other legacy languages. AI helps understand, document and migrate them.
The challenge
Where AI helps

x: Explaining what a program does in plain language
Extracting business rules from code
Generating tests that capture current behaviour before changes
Translating code to modern languages, with human verification

deep.x: SAP context
Moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA requires reviewing custom ABAP code for compatibility. AI tools speed up analysis and remediation.
An estimated hundreds of billions of lines of COBOL are still in use, especially in banking, insurance and government.

cards.title: Documentación
cards.text: La IA redacta y actualiza documentación, descripciones de API y runbooks a partir del código y del historial de commits, reduciendo una tarea que los desarrolladores suelen saltarse.

deep.x: Documentation is essential and often neglected. AI can write and update it from code, commit history and tickets.
Keeping it current
Living documentation

x: Generate API docs from code and schemas
Summarise pull requests into release notes
Create runbooks from incident reports

deep.x: Caution
Use AI to remove the chore, and humans to add the "why".

cards.title: Pruebas
cards.text: La IA genera pruebas unitarias, datos de prueba y casos límite, y aumenta rápidamente la cobertura. Los desarrolladores siguen comprobando que las pruebas prueban lo que deben.

deep.x: AI generates unit tests, test data and edge cases quickly. Developers still need to check the tests actually verify the right behaviour.

steps: Review: do they test real requirements?

deep.x: Uses
The trap
AI-written tests may simply confirm what the code currently does, including its bugs. A test that checks the wrong behaviour gives false confidence.
Measuring test quality

x: Coverage shows which lines run, not whether the checks are meaningful
Mutation testing deliberately introduces bugs to see whether tests catch them

deep.x: Generating tests before refactoring legacy code is one of AI's most valuable uses: it locks in current behaviour so changes are safer.

cards.title: Low-code y desarrolladores ciudadanos
cards.text: La IA facilita que quienes no son desarrolladores creen automatizaciones y pequeñas apps, pero hace falta gobernanza en seguridad, acceso a datos y mantenimiento.

deep.x: AI makes it easier for non-developers to build automations, apps and reports. This unlocks ideas but needs governance.
Tools
Governance basics

x: Approved platforms with built-in security
Data access rules and connectors controlled by IT
Registration of apps that handle business data
Ownership and handover when creators leave

deep.x: Fusion teams
Empower builders, but give them guardrails and a path to production.

cards.title: Seguridad del código escrito por IA
cards.text: Vigila los secretos incrustados en el código, los fallos de inyección, las bibliotecas obsoletas y los nombres de paquetes alucinados que podrían registrar los atacantes.

deep.x: AI-written code can introduce security issues, and attackers have started exploiting the ways AI tools make mistakes.
Slopsquatting

Code assistants sometimes suggest software packages that don't exist. Attackers can register those names with malicious code, so a developer who installs the suggested package gets malware. Research in 2024 found a notable share of package suggestions from some models were hallucinated.
Defences

x: Verify every new dependency exists and is reputable
Use private package registries and allow-lists
Scan code for secrets and vulnerabilities automatically
Review authentication, input handling and permissions carefully

deep.x: Agent permissions
OWASP lists "supply chain" among the top risks for LLM applications, and AI-assisted development extends that risk to the software being built.

cards.title: Medir el impacto en la ingeniería
cards.text: Sigue el tiempo de ciclo, la frecuencia de despliegue, la tasa de fallos en los cambios, la satisfacción de los desarrolladores y el tiempo dedicado a tareas tediosas, no las líneas de código generadas.

deep.x: Measure AI's impact on engineering through delivery outcomes, not lines of code or the share of code written by AI.
DORA metrics
The four delivery metrics above, popularised by Google's DORA research programme, are the standard way to measure software delivery performance.
Bad metrics

items.r: Lead time and change failure rate

deep.x: Measuring well

x: Compare teams before and after, or with and without AI
Track rework and bug rates, not just speed
Survey developers on toil and satisfaction

deep.x: More code is not the goal; better software delivered faster is.

quiz.q: ¿Qué debe pasar con el código generado por IA antes de fusionarlo?
options: Revisión humana, pruebas y análisis de seguridad
quiz.explain: Siguen aplicándose los controles de calidad habituales.

quiz.q: ¿Qué es el riesgo de un «paquete alucinado»?
options: Que la IA sugiera una biblioteca inexistente cuyo nombre podrían registrar los atacantes
quiz.explain: Riesgo de la cadena de suministro.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál es una buena medida del impacto de la IA en la ingeniería?
options: Tiempo de ciclo y tasa de fallos en los cambios
quiz.explain: Mide resultados, no volumen de producción.

lessons.title: Medir el valor de la IA
lessons.summary: KPI, paneles e informes honestos.

cards.title: Resultados, no actividad
cards.text: Cuenta resultados (costes ahorrados, ingresos obtenidos, errores evitados, tiempo de atención al cliente), no actividad (número de prompts, pilotos lanzados, usuarios invitados).

deep.x: AI programmes often report activity, such as pilots launched or users invited, because it's easy to count. Leadership needs outcomes: money saved, revenue gained, errors avoided.
Chain from activity to value

steps: Outcome: capacity freed or cost avoided

deep.x: Questions to ask

x: What changed in the business because of this?
Who would notice if we switched it off?
Where did the freed time go?

deep.x: Freed time
Time saved only becomes value if it's used: more volume handled without hiring, faster service, better analysis, or reduced overtime and contractors.
If you can't name the outcome, you can't claim the value.

cards.title: Tres niveles de métricas
cards.text: Sigue el uso (¿la gente lo usa?), el rendimiento (¿es preciso y rápido?) y el impacto en el negocio (¿crea valor?).

deep.x: Track AI at three levels. Each answers a different question, and problems at a lower level explain results at a higher one.

items: Business impact: is it creating value?
Performance: is it accurate and fast?

deep.x: Examples per level

items.b: weekly active users, tasks per user
cost per invoice, cycle time, revenue

deep.x: Diagnosing

x: Low usage: adoption problem, so look at training, integration, trust
High usage, low performance: quality problem
Good performance, no impact: process not redesigned or freed time not used

deep.x: Who looks at what
Use all three levels to find where value is getting stuck.

cards.title: Métricas de productividad
cards.text: El tiempo por tarea, el volumen por persona, las tasas sin intervención, el tamaño de la cartera pendiente y los tiempos de ciclo muestran los efectos en la productividad.

deep.x: Productivity metrics show how AI changes the amount of work done per person and the speed of processes.
Measuring time per task
Pitfalls

x: Self-reported time savings are often overstated
Measure with system timestamps where possible
Account for review time added by AI
Watch quality alongside speed

deep.x: Throughput
Many organisations use AI gains to absorb growth or clear backlogs rather than reduce headcount, which is still real, measurable value.

cards.title: Métricas de calidad
cards.text: Las tasas de error, el retrabajo, los hallazgos de cumplimiento y las quejas de clientes muestran si la IA mejora o empeora la calidad.

deep.x: Speed means little if quality drops. Quality metrics show whether AI improves or harms the work.
Examples
Quality can improve
AI checks every case consistently, without fatigue, which can reduce errors compared with manual processes. Many teams find AI catches issues humans miss.
Or degrade

x: Sample outputs regularly for expert review
Track errors by type and source

deep.x: Measure quality before and after, or you won't know which way it went.

cards.title: Métricas financieras
cards.text: Traduce las mejoras a dinero: costes evitados, aumento de ingresos, capital circulante liberado, pérdidas por riesgo evitadas, y compáralo con los costes completos.

deep.x: Ultimately, AI value must be translated into money and compared with the full cost of building and running it.
Types of financial benefit
Full costs

x: Licences and model usage
Build and integration effort
Run costs: infrastructure, support, monitoring
Change management and training
Human review time that remains

deep.x: Working capital example

x: Invoices processed 5 days faster
Early-payment discounts of 1% captured on €20M of spend

deep.x: Finance trusts numbers it can trace back to transactions.

cards.title: Grupos de control
cards.text: Siempre que puedas, compara equipos o periodos con y sin IA. Si no, las mejoras podrían deberse a otros cambios.

deep.x: To know whether AI caused an improvement, compare with a group or period without it. Otherwise other changes, such as seasonality, new staff or process tweaks, may explain the result.
Methods
Example
Practical tips

x: Plan the comparison before rollout
Keep the measurement period long enough to smooth out noise
Watch for novelty effects that fade

deep.x: Randomised experiments are the gold standard in medicine and online platforms, and they work in business processes too.

cards.title: Paneles
cards.text: Un panel compartido de valor de la IA muestra la adopción, la calidad y el valor de cada caso de uso frente a sus objetivos, y aporta transparencia a la dirección.

deep.x: A shared AI value dashboard gives leadership one view of all use cases: adoption, quality and value against targets.
Design principles

x: Same metrics definitions across use cases
Targets and trends, not just current values
Drill-down from portfolio to use case
Data pulled automatically, not typed into slides

deep.x: Example view
Who uses it
Transparency builds trust: show the misses as well as the hits.

cards.title: Indicadores adelantados
cards.text: El valor suele llegar con retraso. Señales tempranas como la adopción, la satisfacción y la reducción del tiempo de gestión anticipan los resultados financieros posteriores.

deep.x: Financial results from AI often lag by months. Leading indicators give early signals of whether value will follow.
Common leading indicators
Using them

x: Set expectations: early months show adoption, later months show money
Intervene early when leading indicators are weak
Confirm the link: do leading indicators actually predict later results?

deep.x: Don't wait a year to find out a use case isn't working.

cards.title: Informes honestos
cards.text: Informa de lo que no funcionó, no solo de los éxitos. La credibilidad ante finanzas y la dirección nace de cifras realistas.

deep.x: Credibility with finance and leadership comes from realistic numbers, including what didn't work.
Common inflation tricks to avoid

items.b: same saving claimed by two projects
ignoring review time and run costs

deep.x: Measured vs estimated
Label clearly which benefits are measured from transactions and which are estimates. Finance teams discount unlabelled numbers.
Underpromise and prove: credible numbers secure the next budget.

cards.title: Visión de cartera
cards.text: Gestiona la IA como una cartera: algunos casos de uso dan grandes éxitos, muchos mejoras modestas y otros fracasan. Lo que importa es el retorno total de la cartera.

deep.x: Manage AI as a portfolio, like venture investing: some use cases deliver big wins, many modest gains, some fail. The total return is what matters.
Portfolio management

x: Review quarterly: scale, continue, fix or stop
Balance quick wins and long-term bets
Balance risk levels and business areas
Reallocate funding from failures to winners

deep.x: Typical pattern
A small number of use cases usually generate most of the value. Finding and scaling those matters more than launching many small projects.
This "power law" distribution of returns is common in innovation portfolios, from venture capital to R&D.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál es una métrica de resultado?
quiz.explain: Los resultados reflejan el valor.

quiz.q: ¿Por qué usar grupos de control?
options: Para separar el efecto de la IA del de otros cambios
quiz.explain: Una comparación justa.

quiz.q: ¿Qué es un indicador adelantado del valor de la IA?
options: La adopción y la reducción del tiempo de gestión
quiz.explain: Las señales tempranas anticipan los resultados posteriores.

lessons.title: Estrategia y hoja de ruta de IA
lessons.summary: Juntarlo todo.

cards.title: La estrategia parte de los objetivos de negocio
cards.text: Una estrategia de IA debe servir a la estrategia de la empresa: crecimiento, eficiencia, riesgo, experiencia del cliente. Cada iniciativa de IA se vincula a un objetivo de negocio.

deep.x: An AI strategy serves the company strategy. Start with business goals, then ask where AI can help achieve them, not the other way round.
Linking to goals
Avoid technology-first

items.r: "We need to cut order-to-cash time by 30%, where can AI help?"

deep.x: Questions for leadership

x: Which strategic goals matter most in the next three years?
Where are our biggest costs, delays and risks?
Where do competitors already use AI?
What data do we have that others don't?

deep.x: AI is a means; the business goal is the end.

cards.title: Niveles de ambición
cards.text: Las empresas van desde experimentar, pasando por escalar casos de uso seleccionados, hasta transformar con IA sus procesos centrales y modelos de negocio.

deep.x: Companies choose how far to go with AI. Ambition should match strategy, capabilities and risk appetite.

items: Transform: new business models and core processes
Scale: AI embedded in many processes

deep.x: Characteristics

items.b: processes and products redesigned around AI

deep.x: Moving up

x: Experimenting builds skills and identifies opportunities
Scaling needs foundations: platform, data, governance
Transformation needs leadership commitment and organisational change

deep.x: Fast followers
Most large companies by 2025 were somewhere between experimenting and scaling, with few at transformation level.

cards.title: La hoja de ruta
cards.text: Una hoja de ruta ordena casos de uso y bases a lo largo de 12–36 meses, por oleadas: primero victorias rápidas, bases en paralelo y transformaciones mayores después.

deep.x: An AI roadmap sequences use cases and foundations over 12 to 36 months, typically in waves.
Wave logic
Example roadmap items

items.b: assistant for all staff, invoice extraction

deep.x: Keep it flexible
Revisit the roadmap every quarter. New model capabilities and lower costs can make previously impossible use cases suddenly viable.
A roadmap is a plan for learning, not a fixed contract.

cards.title: Bases en paralelo
cards.text: Datos, plataforma, gobernanza, seguridad y competencias deben construirse junto con los casos de uso, no después. Cada oleada de casos de uso financia y aprovecha las bases.

deep.x: Data, platform, governance, security and skills must be built alongside use cases, not after. Each wave of use cases both uses and funds the foundations.
Why in parallel
The answer is to do both together, letting each use case pay for the foundations it needs.
Use cases pull foundations
Typical foundations

x: Approved AI gateway and models
Knowledge layer with permissions
Data catalogue and quality processes
Policy, inventory and risk review
Literacy training

deep.w: You must fix all your data before using AI
deep.r: fix the data each priority use case needs, and improve the rest over time

cards.title: Modelo operativo
cards.text: Decide quién financia, desarrolla, posee y gobierna la IA: modelo central, federado o híbrido. El híbrido hub-and-spoke es habitual en las grandes empresas globales.

deep.x: The operating model defines who funds, builds, owns and governs AI. The choice shapes speed, consistency and accountability.

items: Federated: business units decide and build

deep.x: Trade-offs

items.b: consistent, controlled, but slower and further from business
close to business, but duplication and uneven controls
balance of both, most common in large firms

deep.x: Key decisions

x: Who decides priorities?
Who pays for platforms and for use cases?
Who owns solutions after launch?
Who sets and enforces standards?

deep.x: Evolution
Choose the model that fits your company's culture and current maturity, and expect to evolve it.

cards.title: Alianzas
cards.text: Los socios estratégicos (proveedores de nube, proveedores de modelos, integradores, startups) aceleran la entrega. Mantén en casa la arquitectura y las competencias clave.

deep.x: Partners accelerate delivery, but key architecture and skills should stay in-house to avoid dependency.
What to buy and what to keep
Avoiding lock-in

x: Use a gateway that can switch model providers
Keep prompts, evaluation sets and data in your control
Prefer open standards (MCP, OpenAI-compatible APIs)
Ensure knowledge transfer from consultants

deep.x: Startups
Startups offer innovation and speed; assess their financial stability, security practices and data handling carefully.
Universities and research centres, such as those in Portugal's tech ecosystem, can be valuable partners for talent and advanced problems.

cards.title: Modelo de financiación
cards.text: Financia las bases de forma central y los casos de uso desde las unidades de negocio (con cofinanciación central para empezar), y revisa la cartera cada trimestre.

deep.x: How AI is funded affects what gets built and who cares about results.

items.b: funded by business units that benefit

deep.x: Why split funding
A split model gives business ownership of results and secure funding for foundations.
Gates
Chargeback
Charging usage costs back to business units through the gateway makes costs visible and encourages efficient use.
Those who benefit from a use case should pay for it, so they care about the results.

cards.title: Los agentes y el futuro
cards.text: A medida que maduren los agentes, podrán automatizarse más procesos de principio a fin con supervisión humana. Prepárate ya: API limpias, procesos claros, buenos datos y gobernanza para las acciones autónomas.

deep.x: AI agents that can plan and act across systems are maturing quickly. More end-to-end processes may become automated with human oversight.
What's changing
Preparing now

x: Document processes clearly: agents need explicit rules
Expose systems through secure APIs or MCP servers
Define approval thresholds for autonomous actions
Build monitoring and audit for agent actions

deep.x: Human role shifts

deep.w: Agents will soon run companies on their own
deep.r: reliability, security and accountability still require strong human oversight for important actions

cards.title: Mantente adaptable
cards.text: Los modelos, los precios y la normativa cambian rápido. Revisa la estrategia al menos una vez al año, mantén una arquitectura flexible y evita apostarlo todo a un solo proveedor.

deep.x: AI models, prices and regulations change every few months. A good strategy expects change and stays flexible.
Sources of change
Design for flexibility

x: Gateway architecture to switch models
Evaluation sets to test new models quickly
Avoid long, rigid contracts for fast-moving technology
Keep multiple vendors in the catalogue

deep.x: Review rhythm
Bet on capabilities and learning, not on a single vendor or model.

cards.title: Las personas en el centro
cards.text: Las empresas que triunfan con la IA combinan la tecnología con personas que conocen el negocio, confianza ganada con prácticas responsables y una cultura de aprendizaje.

deep.x: Technology alone doesn't create advantage: competitors can buy the same models. Lasting advantage comes from people, processes, data and culture.
What competitors can't copy easily
Building the culture

x: Encourage experimentation and sharing
Recognise people who create value with AI
Invest in skills continuously
Keep responsible practices that earn trust

deep.x: The winning combination
The companies that win with AI are the ones whose people learn fastest.

quiz.q: ¿A qué debe servir una estrategia de IA?
